title: A later turn's run of the same id-less Codex/ACP command line is folded into an earlier unended observed row: the live run shows no row of its own
outcome: Each run of a recognized test that a later turn starts gets its own host-observed test-run row, even when an earlier turn's run of the same id-less command line is still unended; a runtime's repeated start of the same run within its turn (ACP) still deduplicates; and each row is finalized only by its own run's end.
acceptance: C1 (a run of its own). When a recognized test starts under a key (Ambient provenance: Codex, ACP) for which an unended host-observed row exists from an EARLIER turn generation, the start creates its own row for the current turn. A repeat start within the SAME turn generation, as ACP re-sends, still deduplicates to the existing row.

C2 (an in-turn end ends its own turn's row). An end observed through the in-turn path with Ambient provenance, keyed by its command line, finalizes only the unended row of the current turn generation when one exists, never an earlier turn's row; ends with an id stay keyed by their unique id. Claude provenance stays as now, already turn-filtered.

C3 (a late end ends the row of the turn it is tagged with). A late end through the reported-end path, tagged with a Codex turn id, finalizes and annotates only the unended row started in the TermAl turn that Codex turn ran in, resolved from a bounded in-memory mapping recorded when commands start under that turn. With no tag, or a tag that can't be resolved (unknown, evicted, or lost to a restart), a late end keyed by its command line touches no row; a late end of an item with an id keeps finalizing and annotating the row of that id, as now. This replaces w-1b4f's blanket line-key skip with a precise filter. The tell and the carried-test take are unchanged.

C4 (tests, through the real shared app-server path): 2 and 3 overlapping turns of the same id-less line each get their own row; turn 1's late end, tagged turn-1, ends only turn 1's row, in both cases; turn 2's in-turn end ends only turn 2's row; an ACP-style repeat start in the same turn makes no second row; the lone late end, with no turn running, ends its own row (the carried pin); a late end with an unresolvable tag changes no row. The existing w-d0b8d75c4ad6 tests (observed rows reach a terminal state) pass unchanged, and a row whose late end can't be resolved is still closed by the existing w-d0b8 terminal paths rather than left running.
C5 (validation). The review pair has no outstanding finding of Medium or higher; focused checks pass on the frozen input; it lands after w-2dcd.
